My AI Productivity Stack as a Solo Creator — What I Use Every Day

After months of testing, here's my actual daily AI workflow. 7 tools, $50/month, replacing what used to require a team of 5.

The Stack

I'm a solo creator running a production company, writing content, and managing client work. Here's what I use every single day to make it work.

Research: Perplexity Pro

$20/month. Replaced Google and RSS readers. I ask questions, it answers. Simple.

Writing: Claude

$20/month. For drafting articles, emails, and client communications. The best AI for nuanced, long-form content.

Code: Cursor

$20/month. For building and maintaining websites. Has replaced most of what I'd hire a developer for.

Images: Midjourney

$30/month. For all visual content. Still the best for creative, artistic image generation.

Video: Kling + Runway

$50/month combined. For video generation and editing assistance. Each has different strengths.

Voice: ElevenLabs

$5/month. For voiceovers and narration. Professional quality at a fraction of studio costs.

Scheduling: Claude (again)

Using Claude for calendar management, email drafting, and task prioritization. It's my executive assistant.

The Cost

Total: roughly $150/month. Replacing what used to require: researcher, writer, developer, designer, video editor, voice actor, and executive assistant.

The math works. Even at scale, AI tools cost a fraction of hiring humans. And they work 24/7.

The Honest Take

AI doesn't replace humans. But it does multiply what a single person can accomplish. I'm more productive now than at any point in my 20-year career. And I work fewer hours.

Rating: 9/10 — This stack has changed how I work. I'm doing the work of 5 people in 40 hours a week.
